container.title: Russia's first container truck on the KAMAZ-65658 chassis has been manufactured by Rustrak
desc: LLC Rustrak has developed a container truck on the KAMAZ 65658-1766-49 chassis — the first project of its kind in Russia based on this chassis. It is a compact and manoeuvrable solution for container logistics. The vehicle is designed to transport dangerous goods in FL and AT vehicle categories according to ADR classification.

comvex.title: Rustrak summed up the results of its participation in the COMVEX 2026 exhibition
desc: LLC Rustrak successfully completed its work at the largest industry event of the year. The Rustrak exhibition attracted the attention of a wide range of specialists, experts, and business representatives in the commercial vehicle sector.

Throughout the exhibition, the company team actively worked at the stand, holding meetings and negotiations with existing partners and new clients. During the business programme, key areas for further cooperation were outlined, and a number of important agreements aimed at developing partnerships were reached.
We thank all visitors to our stand for their interest, trust, and productive dialogue. See you next time!

sadko.title: Sadko 9 Farmer has been equipped with a crane manipulator and drilling rig
desc: The Rustrak plant installed a crane manipulator with a TAURUS 035A drilling and crane unit on the Sadko NEXT 9 chassis.

The Sadko 9 with a loader crane and drilling equipment meets the needs of energy, construction, and utility companies for vehicles capable of operating effectively off-road. The versatile equipment, combined with an all-wheel-drive chassis and double cab, minimises downtime in off-road conditions.

Comment by Dmitry Leonidovich Dolgovanin, Chief Designer of the Rustrak plant: «This vehicle will operate in the energy sector, but its range of applications — from geological exploration, construction, and oil and gas to utilities — significantly reduces task completion time. In fact, it is an autonomous unit capable of replacing several specialised machines».
parametrs: Lifting capacity: 3.5 tonnes at 2 metres and 350 kg at 12.5 metres
Drilling rig with a drilling depth of up to 8 metres
Continuous 360° column rotation around its axis

Curtain sider semi-trailer repair ensures the restoration of structural performance after intensive operation. Our masters take into account the design features of components and use proven maintenance methods. «RusTrak» company in Nizhny Novgorod offers service focused on quality and equipment durability. We restore the trailer structure, repair the frame and side curtains, fix doors, locks and opening mechanisms, and also restore the trailer floor and sides. production_page.title: Production
production_page.desc1: Automobile plant «RusTrak» is a leading manufacturer of commercial vehicles and specialized equipment in Nizhny Novgorod. Our products are vans, flatbed platforms, crane manipulators, workshops, food tankers, fuel tankers, aerial platforms, dump trucks, vacuum trucks, tow trucks, hook loaders. All vehicles are assembled at our own production facility.
production_page.desc2: The production facilities of «RusTrak» consist of 3 buildings with a total area of over 7,000 square meters. The machine park is equipped with modern high-tech equipment, which determines the high quality of finished products. The company uses components from well-known global and domestic manufacturers. Today, the company's output capacity is from 110 units per month.
production_page.staff_desc: The key to the quality of products of LLC «RusTrak» is the work of a team of professionals on the company's technological equipment. The company's management cares about its employees, creating the most comfortable working conditions and improving the professional training of employees. Every six months, the company's employees undergo re-certification of knowledge and skills and take advanced training courses.
production_page.bureau_desc: «RusTrak» company has its own design and technological bureau, which works in close cooperation with production. This working scheme allows to constantly improve and modernize the manufactured special equipment, taking into account the wishes of our clients. We are ready to manufacture a vehicle for almost any need!
production_page.quality_desc: Quality control of our products is carried out at all stages of production. We use only reliable components, purchasing them from trusted suppliers. «RusTrak» specialists strictly monitor the implementation of production technology. Constant testing and trials of manufactured products eliminate the receipt of claims. The global practice of product conformity certification has been introduced at the production: each unit of special equipment that leaves our production has an international standard certificate (ISO 9001).
production_page.desc3: The quality control department evaluates each unit of equipment, which guarantees our customers a long service life and trouble-free operation of the equipment.

credit_page.item1_title: Credit and leasing for special vehicles by RusTrak
credit_page.item1_desc: RusTrak provides the opportunity to purchase commercial special equipment on credit and leasing. We work with all banks and leasing companies. Remember, you can choose any leasing company that suits you.
credit_page.item2_desc: Down payment amount is 5-30% of the equipment cost. Appreciation of the leasing object per year is 8-9%. Leasing payment period ranges from 6 months to 5 years. After full settlement of the leasing, the equipment becomes the property of your firm.
credit_page.item3_desc: Maximum payment deferral. Accelerated depreciation: participants in a leasing transaction have the right to apply the mechanism of accelerated depreciation of the leasing subject with an acceleration factor of up to 3, which allows for faster payback on equipment and flexibility in contract duration. Tax optimization: all payments under the leasing agreement are attributed to the cost of production, thereby reducing the taxable base for income tax. Savings for the lessee due to no property tax obligations, as the leased asset usually remains on the leasing company's balance sheet. Ability to acquire and use property without diverting the enterprise's own funds all at once. Ability to acquire ownership of the leased asset, completely free from tax burden, upon expiration of the leasing contract. Independent selection of the leasing subject and its seller by the lessee.
credit_page.type1_desc: The lessor (leasing company) acquires ownership of the property specified by the lessee from a certain seller and transfers this property to the lessee as a leasing object under certain conditions for temporary possession and use. The property transfers to the lessee provided that all leasing payments are made.
credit_page.type2_desc: The property is not bought out by the lessee, but remains the property of the leasing company and, after the expiration of the leasing contract, is leased or rented out again.
credit_page.type3_desc: An enterprise buys property with its own funds and then applies to a leasing company. This is one way to quickly return working capital. The leasing company considers the property as a leasing object and purchases it under a sales contract from the enterprise. The same property is then leased back to the same enterprise.
credit_page.partner_desc: CARCADE is a universal leasing partner. CARCADE finances the purchase of both passenger cars and commercial vehicles. Commercial vehicles or special equipment can be leased without providing financial statements using just 2 documents. Transaction terms: down payment from 4% to 50%, leasing term from 12 to 60 months, final payment from 1% to 15%. Additional benefits for CARCADE clients: comprehensive insurance in installments, free assignment, electronic document management. For more detailed information on special equipment and leasing options, call: 8 (831) 225-00-55
